blocks.tamil_translation: Accordingly, he expressed his wish to the Prophet ﷺ. The Prophet ﷺ said, “Do not do that!” For one of you standing (for a little while) in the path of Allah Ta'ala is better than his performing Salah for seventy years while staying in his house. Do you not wish that Allah Ta'ala should forgive you and admit you into Jannah? Strive (do Jihad) in the path of Allah Ta'ala. Whoever fights in the path of Allah Ta'ala even for the time between the first squeeze and the second squeeze of a she-camel's udder when milking it (a mere few moments), Jannah becomes obligatory for him.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ صُدِعَ رَأْسُهُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ فَاحْتَسَبَ، غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا كَانَ قَبْلَ ذلِكَ مِنْ ذَنْبٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الكبير واسناده حسن، مجمع الزوائد:٣ /٣٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Whoever gets a headache in the path of Allah Ta'ala and hopes from Allah that he will receive reward for it, all his previous sins will be forgiven.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِيمَا يَحْكِي عَنْ رَبِّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَي قَالَ: أَيُّمَا عَبْدٍ مِنْ عِبَادِي خَرَجَ مُجَاهِدًا فِي سَبِيلِي ابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاتِيْ ضَمِنْتُ لَهُ أَنْ أَرْجِعَهُ بِمَا أَصَابَ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَغَنِيمَةٍ وَإِنْ قَبَضْتُهُ أَنْ أَغْفِرَ لَهُ، وَأَرْحَمَهُ وَأُدْخِلَهُ الْجَنَّةَ.
